shorts_extract.hook: Flashed a chicken claw on the right and snow on the left, a split-brain patient points his left hand at a snow shovel — and his mouth instantly invents a chicken-shed excuse.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Cutting the 200-million-axon corpus callosum isolates left-visual-field images inside the silent right hemisphere while the speaking left hemisphere confabulates explanations.
shorts_extract.twist: You have the exact same 'left-hemisphere interpreter' inside your intact brain, inventing sensible stories for unconscious impulses every day.
